mapper.select: select request_key,owner_id,member_no,initial_trace_id,status,retry_count,created_at,updated_at, case when response_json is null then false else true end as has_response from signup_request where request_key=#{key} for update
select (select count(*) from member where member_no=#{memberNo}) + (select count(*) from member_process where business_key=#{memberNo} and status='SUCCESS')
mapper.update: update signup_request set status='RETRY_ALLOWED',updated_at=#{now} where request_key=#{key} and status='RECOVERY_REQUIRED' and response_json is null
mapper.select: select event_id,actor,action,reason_code,trace_id,created_at from signup_recovery_audit where request_key=#{key} order by created_at,event_id limit 100
